Data the Company Needs to Provide: Direct GHG emissions from owned/controlled sources. Break-up into: CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6, NF3 (if available). Current year + previous year comparison.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total Scope 1 emissions (Break-up of the GHG into CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6, NF3, if available)
Notes: Covers all direct combustion, process emissions, fugitive emissions. GHG Protocol Scope 1 definition applies.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Indirect GHG emissions from purchased electricity/heat/steam. Location-based OR market-based method. Break-up into: CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6, NF3 (if available). Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total Scope 2 emissions (Break-up of the GHG into CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6, NF3, if available)
Notes: Use location-based method as default. State methodology (market-based vs location-based).

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Combined Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions divided by total turnover in INR crore. Current + previous year. Optionally: intensity per unit of product/service.
Unit: Metric tonnes CO2e per INR crore turnover
Regulatory Language (SEBI): GHG Emission Intensity per rupee of turnover (Total Scope 1 and Scope 2 emission in metric tonnes CO2 equivalent per INR crore of turnover). Optional: intensity per unit of product/service.
Notes: Denominator = total revenue from operations. Specify if optional unit-based intensity is also reported.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Volume of water drawn from all sources: surface water, groundwater, third-party water, seawater, others. Separate freshwater (≤1000 mg/L TDS) from other water. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total volume of water withdrawn (break-up by source: surface water, groundwater, third-party water, seawater, others; distinguish freshwater from other water)
Notes: Use local definition of freshwater or WHO/IS 10500 standard. Source-wise break-up required.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Net water consumed = withdrawal minus discharge. Separated into freshwater and other water. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total volume of water consumed (as difference of water withdrawal and water discharged)
Notes: If water recycled internally, ensure it is not double-counted in withdrawal.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Total water consumed divided by total turnover in INR crore. Current + previous year. Optionally per unit of product.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Water consumption intensity per rupee of turnover. Optional: per unit of product/service.
Notes: Enables cross-company comparability.

Field / KPI Name: Water Discharge by Destination and Treatment
Data the Company Needs to Provide: Volume discharged to: surface water, groundwater, seawater, third-party/water treatment facility, others. For each destination: treatment level (primary, secondary, tertiary, untreated). Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Water discharge by destination and levels of treatment (destination-wise break-up: surface water, groundwater, seawater, third-party, others; with treatment level for each)
Notes: Include only externally discharged water. Internal recirculation excluded.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Volume of water recycled and reused within operations. As % of total water withdrawal. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total water recycled and reused within the entity as a percentage of total water withdrawal
Notes: Captures circular water use efficiency. Does not include single-pass cooling water.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Energy consumed from: coal, lignite, oil, natural gas, other fossil fuels, purchased conventional electricity, purchased heat/steam/cooling from non-renewable sources. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total energy consumed from non-renewable sources (fuel, purchased electricity, purchased heat, steam, cooling)
Notes: Use GJ as primary unit. If using kWh convert at 1 kWh = 0.0036 GJ. Specify fuel types.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Energy consumed from: solar, wind, biomass, geothermal, tidal, hydropower, purchased renewable electricity (including RECs). Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total energy consumed from renewable sources (renewable fuel, purchased renewable electricity, purchased renewable heat, steam, cooling)
Notes: Include own generation + purchased renewable energy certificates (RECs).

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Sum of energy from renewable and non-renewable sources. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total energy consumed (renewable + non-renewable)
Notes: Cross-check: Attribute 9 + Attribute 10. Report % from renewables explicitly.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Total energy consumed divided by total turnover in INR crore. Current + previous year. Optionally per unit of product/service.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Energy intensity per rupee of turnover. Optional: per unit of product/service.
Notes: Standard denominator = revenue from operations.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Total plastic waste generated (packaging, single-use plastics, industrial plastic scrap, etc.). Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Plastic waste generated (in metric tonnes)
Notes: Covers all plastics including rigid and flexible packaging.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Electrical and electronic equipment waste generated. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): E-waste generated (in metric tonnes)
Notes: WEEE categories as per E-Waste Management Rules 2022.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Waste arising from healthcare, research, or pharmaceutical activities. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Bio-medical waste generated (in metric tonnes)
Notes: Applicable mainly to pharma/healthcare sector companies. Others may report zero with explanation.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Waste from construction, renovation, or demolition activities. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Construction and demolition waste generated (in metric tonnes)
Notes: Report actuals; if no C&D activity, report zero with statement.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Lead-acid, lithium-ion, and other battery waste. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Battery waste generated (in metric tonnes)
Notes: Governed by Battery Waste Management Rules 2022.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Radioactive waste from operations (if applicable). Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Radioactive waste generated (in metric tonnes)
Notes: Applicable mainly to nuclear/power sector. Others may report zero.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Hazardous waste not captured in categories above (solvents, chemicals, fly ash classified as hazardous, etc.). Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Other hazardous waste generated (in metric tonnes) — hazardous waste as per Hazardous Waste Management Rules
Notes: As per Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules 2016.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Non-hazardous solid waste not captured above (general scrap, process waste, food waste, etc.). Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Other non-hazardous waste generated (in metric tonnes)
Notes: Report by waste stream where possible.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Sum of all waste types above. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total waste generated (in metric tonnes)
Notes: Cross-check: sum of KPIs 13–20.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Total waste generated divided by total turnover in INR crore. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Waste intensity per rupee of turnover (total waste in MT per INR crore of turnover)
Notes: Enables cross-company comparability.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Waste diverted from disposal via: recycling, reusing, composting, other recovery operations. Breakdown by recovery method. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total waste recovered through recycling, re-using or other recovery operations (with break-up by recovery method)
Notes: Excludes waste to landfill or incineration without energy recovery.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Waste directed to disposal via: incineration (with energy recovery), incineration (without energy recovery), landfilling, other disposal. Break-up by method. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Total waste disposed by disposal mechanism (incineration with energy recovery, incineration without energy recovery, landfill, other disposal — with break-up)
Notes: Cross-check: KPI 23 + KPI 24 = KPI 21 (recovered + disposed = total generated).

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Total cost incurred on wellbeing measures for permanent employees (health insurance, maternity/paternity benefits, daycare, education assistance, etc.) as % of total revenue from operations.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Cost incurred on measures towards wellbeing of employees (permanent) as a percentage of total revenue from operations
Notes: Include all welfare schemes per BRSR Section C. Denominator = revenue from operations (not profit).

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Same as above but for contractual/casual/daily wage workers employed by the entity.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Cost incurred on measures towards wellbeing of workers (contractual/casual) as a percentage of total revenue from operations
Notes: Captures care extended beyond permanent payroll.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) for permanent employees. Also: number of high-consequence work-related injuries, number of fatalities, total recordable work-related injuries. Current + previous year.
Unit: LTIFR per million man-hours worked; absolute count for fatalities
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Details of safety-related incidents for employees: LTIFR (per one million-person hours worked), number of fatalities, high consequence work-related injuries (excluding fatalities), total recordable work-related injuries
Notes: LTIFR = (Number of LTI cases × 1

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Same safety metrics for contractual/daily-wage workers and contractors deployed on-site. Current + previous year.
Unit: LTIFR per million man-hours; absolute count for fatalities
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Details of safety-related incidents for workers (contractual/casual): LTIFR, number of fatalities, high consequence injuries, total recordable injuries
Notes: Includes contract workforce deployed within company premises.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Total gross wages (salary + allowances + bonus) paid to all female employees as a percentage of total gross wages paid to all employees. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Gross wages paid to females as a percentage of salary paid (total wages paid to female employees as % of total wages paid to all employees)
Notes: 'Wages' = total gross pay including variable pay, ex-gratia, but typically excluding ESOP. Define scope clearly.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Number of complaints filed under the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Act (Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013) during the year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Number of complaints on sexual harassment received during the year (POSH Act)
Notes: Mandatory disclosure per POSH Act. Include all complaints to Internal Committee (IC) and Local Committee (LC).

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Number of POSH complaints pending resolution at the end of the financial year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Number of complaints on sexual harassment pending as at end of year (POSH Act)
Notes: Pending = filed but not disposed of. Disposals = resolved, dismissed, or withdrawn.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Value of input materials (direct raw materials and components) sourced from MSMEs/small producers as % of total purchases by value. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Input material sourced from MSMEs/small producers as a percentage of total purchases (by value)
Notes: MSME as per MSMED Act 2006 (revised Udyam Registration thresholds apply).

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Value of input materials sourced from Indian suppliers (domestic sourcing) as % of total purchases by value. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Input material sourced from within India as a percentage of total purchases (by value)
Notes: Reflects Atmanirbhar Bharat alignment and supply chain resilience.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Total wages/salaries paid to employees/workers employed in aspirational districts, Tier-2/Tier-3 cities, semi-urban, or rural areas as a percentage of total wage cost. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Wages paid to persons employed in aspirational districts/smaller cities as a percentage of total wage cost
Notes: 'Smaller towns' per SEBI = aspirational districts + Tier-2/Tier-3 cities as defined by government. Specify which classification used.

Field / KPI Name: Customer Data Breach / Privacy Loss Incidents
Data the Company Needs to Provide: Number of instances of customer personal data loss, breach, or unauthorized access. Also expressed as % of total cybersecurity incidents reported. Current + previous year.
Unit: Number and % of total cybersecurity incidents
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Number of instances involving loss/breach of customer data and the same as a percentage of total cybersecurity events reported during the year
Notes: Covers breaches under IT Act, PDPB, and CERT-In reporting requirements. Disclose even if nil.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Average number of days of accounts payable outstanding (trade creditors / COGS or revenue × 365). Reflects payment behavior towards suppliers. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Number of days of accounts payable (trade payables / total purchases × 365 days, or equivalent calculation)
Notes: Indicates fairness to suppliers. Formula to be stated. Use year-end or average balance as appropriate.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Purchases from the top 10 trading houses, dealers, and related parties as a percentage of total purchases. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Concentration of purchases — purchases from top 10 trading houses / dealers / related parties as a % of total purchases (by value)
Notes: Discloses vendor concentration risk. Related parties as per Companies Act 2013 / Ind AS 24.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Revenue from top 10 customers as a percentage of total revenue from operations. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Concentration of sales — sales to top 10 customers as a % of total revenue from operations
Notes: Customer concentration metric. Signals market power and revenue dependency.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Value of purchases from related parties as a % of total purchases. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Related party transactions (purchases): value of purchases from related parties as a % of total purchases
Notes: Related parties as per Ind AS 24 / Companies Act Section 188. Cross-reference with RPT disclosures in annual report.

Data the Company Needs to Provide: Value of sales to related parties as a % of total revenue from operations. Current + previous year.
Regulatory Language (SEBI): Related party transactions (sales): value of sales to related parties as a % of total revenue from operations
Notes: Enables assessment of arm's-length pricing and business independence.
